en: A black‑and‑white vintage view of an open city square with trees, paths, and fenced areas in the foreground. Multi‑storey brick and stone buildings frame the square on the left and right, and in the distance a large church or tower rises above the rooftops. The perspective looks across a tram or car road toward the park-like square. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge, and a small publisher's mark is visible in the lower right corner.
